description: A test script for performance testing Azure OpenAI and a custom router, measuring time to first token in streaming responses.

methods.name: _openai_completion
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous completion request to Azure OpenAI, measuring time to first token from the response stream.

methods.name: _router_completion
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous completion request via a custom router, measuring time to first token from the response stream.

methods.name: test_azure_completion_streaming
methods.description: Runs multiple concurrent streaming completion tests for both Azure OpenAI and the custom router, comparing their response times.
